title: Gmail MCP for Claude: OAuth setup, quotas, and when shared Gmail fails
summary: Set up Gmail MCP in Claude Desktop or Claude Code, cover OAuth scopes and API quotas, and know when a shared Gmail mailbox fails for agents.
body_markdown:
TL;DR


A Gmail MCP server lets Claude read, search, and draft inside a person's existing Gmail through Google OAuth, and Google caps it at 6,000 quota units per minute per user. Personal Gmail also blocks sending past 500 emails a day, and that cap sits on the mailbox owner. Once several agents share one mailbox, one runaway loop eats the cap and one bounce spike hurts the whole address, so give each agent its own inbox.
